verdict.rationale: Community reports describe an 'Improve the model' toggle as a training opt-out, plus zero data retention on the enterprise plan only. An independent wire-level analysis, however, found the whole repo and unredacted .env files are uploaded whether the toggle is on or off. The stopgap is undocumented config flags (disable_codebase_upload, telemetry/trace_upload off) reported by users, one of them unverified. Because no first-party docs describe a training opt-out, there is no vendor-tier claim to dispute; the reports instead limit how far this partial capability can be trusted. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a training opt-out, verified evidence that the toggle actually stops data from being used for training, a no-training guarantee outside the enterprise plan, and officially documented upload-disable settings.
